title: Overnight return predicts the last half hour (index futures literature), intraday-flat compatible
rule: 1-minute ES/NQ: overnight return = price at 09:30 (open of the 09:30 bar) / 16:00 close of the previous session - 1 (same contract); if |overnight| > k x 20-day sd of overnight returns, take sign(overnight) from the 15:30 bar open to the last price before 16:00; 0.5 per index; 2 x cost_frac
